**Required fix strategy:** Since you can only modify user.cpp, you need to prevent the second destructor call from executing on already-freed memory. The fix must add guard logic or intervene in the lifecycle to prevent double-destruction.

Your current plan (initializing stdlib features in user_init() to allocate static objects before custom heap) addresses a different problem and won't fix the double-destruction issue.
